chunks.title: Employer partnerships
chunks.summary: Use this page if you are HR, benefits, or leadership exploring a program for employees. It is not for booking your own visit. Partnership pricing is not published. The next step is Request employer information at siya.health/employers. The page describes inquiry, then a Discovery call to align on scope, then pilot design where pricing and contract terms are set. Screening is not diagnosis, and outcomes are not guaranteed. If they are an employee seeking care themselves, direct them to Meet & Greet instead, not the employer form. Do not answer cost, package name, who pays, or response timeline.

chunks.title: Join the clinical team
chunks.summary: Use this only if they are a clinician asking to join — not a patient asking who they will see. Point to siya.health/join-our-team. This is initial interest, not a contract offer. Arrangements vary by role and state. Clinical leadership follows up by email. The page describes concierge admin support, licensing/credentialing coordination (not legal advice), and adult telehealth in supported states. Do not answer pay, employment type, open roles, schedule, or interview process.
